subject.title: fix(backup): sweep stale temp artifacts before creating new backup

question: After the matcher and rebase defects are fixed, should OpenClaw accept startup deletion of stale backup temp artifacts older than the grace window?
rationale: The repair can be mechanical, but the final merge still intentionally deletes old backup artifacts and depends on age plus owner checks, which is a maintainer-owned risk choice.

options.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup After Repair
options.body: Land once timestamped/retry temp coverage, owner guards, tests, proof, and current-main rebase are all in place.

options.title: Keep Cleanup Manual
options.body: Decline startup deletion and keep the issue open for a doctor/manual janitor design instead.

options.title: Narrow To Staging-Only
options.body: Accept stale staging-dir cleanup but defer archive-temp deletion if partial archives are considered useful recovery/debug artifacts.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup After Repair
recommendation.body: Land once timestamped/retry temp coverage, owner guards, tests, proof, and current-main rebase are all in place.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent backup source, docs, and test history make this the best available routing candidate for the merge-risk decision.
